Maya —

Thanks for the note and the clear list. Im attaching our draft responses (RW_AppendixA_Answers.docx) and a short order form snapshot that shows how we map seats, dedicated capacity, and support tiers to pricing. High-level responses below so you have context before legal reviews them:

- Liability cap: Redwoods standard is a reciprocal cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months, but we can offer a contract-specific fixed cap. For a first-year deal we can do $3M per-occurrence with a $9M aggregate if we agree to certain guardrails (e.g., data residency controls, SOC 2 evidence).
- IP: Customer data and direct derivatives belong to the customer. Model outputs generated by general-purpose models are licensed; we propose a usage license back to the customer for their outputs, with no assignment of Redwood model IP.
- Indemnity: We accept indemnity for third-party IP claims and will carve standard exceptions for healthcare regulatory fines and penalties; we propose mutual indemnity with a negligence threshold and notice + control provisions.
- Exhibit B (HIPAA flow): We can support a Business Associate Agreement; full PHI support requires a Dedicated or Private deployment with encryption keys managed by the customer.

Attachments: RW_AppendixA_Answers.docx, orderform-summary.pdf (embedded in doc)

Ive copied Legal internally for their edits; expect a redline tomorrow. Let me know if you want a short call Monday morning to walk through the items.

Alex / Marissa —

Quick legal take after reviewing RW_AppendixA_Answers.docx and Exhibit B redline (see attached AppendixA_ExhibitB-redline.pdf):

Edits we recommend (summary):
- Liability cap: Accepting $3M/$9M is reasonable provided Hightower: (a) enters a Dedicated or Private deployment within 90 days of contract signature for any PHI scope; (b) confirms data residency (US) in the SOW; and (c) agrees to a 12-month revenue floor for cap calculations. We will not accept an open-ended aggregate beyond 3x the single-occurrence cap unless fees justify.
- Indemnity: Make mutual for third-party IP claims; carve public policy/regulatory fines (HIPAA penalties) as excluded, but accept cooperation obligations for regulatory subpoenas. Add a 30-day cure period and cap Redwoods indemnity to the liability cap.
- IP: Reinforce that customer retains rights to inputs and outputs; provide a limited-performance license to Redwood for model improvement purposes with an opt-out. No assignment of Redwoods model IP.
- Order form: Add explicit throughput metric definitions (tokens/sec, concurrency) and a mechanism for overage credits if sessions exceed provisioned throughput.

Attachments: AppendixA_ExhibitB-redline.pdf (legal redline), suggested clause snippets in inline text. I can convert these into the questionnaire spreadsheet if you want.

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Maya / Evan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached are the consolidated Appendix A responses and a redlined Exhibit B that addresses HIPAA flow and deployment constraints (RW_AppendixA_Answers.docx; AppendixA_ExhibitB-redline.pdf). Highlights:

- Liability cap: Redwood can commit to a $3,000,000 per-occurrence cap and a $9,000,000 aggregate for this agreement, subject to the following commercial guardrails: Dedicated or Private deployment for PHI within 90 days, US data residency, and a 12-month revenue minimum.
- IP & outputs: Customer retains ownership of inputs and direct outputs. Redwood grants a limited, revocable license to use non-identifiable outputs for model improvement unless the customer opts out in the order form. No assignment of Redwood core model IP.
- Indemnity: Mutual indemnity for third-party IP claims; regulatory fines related to healthcare statutes (HIPAA) are excluded. Redwoods indemnity liability limited to the stated cap. 30-day cure and notice/control provisions included.
- Order form: Attached snapshot shows seat vs throughput billing, support tier definitions, SLA credits, and a DocuSign-ready order form placeholder (orderform-docusign-link.txt). Overages are handled via measured throughput windows with crediting for transient spikes.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether the $3M/$9M construct with the listed guardrails is acceptable.
2) If acceptable, we will send a DocuSign-ready order form and the BAA (for PHI scope) for signature.
3) If you prefer a different cap structure, were open to a short call to align commercial offsets.
